actors.description: Watch Natural Product Numbers (NPN / DIN-HM) and emit typed ACTIVE/INACTIVE/company events from the official Health Canada LNHPD Product Licence API. Not a DPD DIN twin; not PMRA; not a national LNHPD dump billed as rows; not openFDA.

actors.name: au-acma-licence-portfolio-monitor
actors.title: ACMA Radiocomms Licence Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch ACMA radiocommunications LICENCE_NO values and emit typed Granted/status/expiry/category/client events from the official Spectrum Licensing LicenceSearchJSON API (optional RRL extracts). Not FCC ULS (US); not a nationwide RRL dump billed as rows; not unpaid spectrum SaaS scrape.

actors.name: australia-abn-status-portfolio-monitor
actors.title: Australia ABN Status Portfolio Monitor
actors.description: Watch a list of Australian Business Numbers and emit typed ABN status / GST / entity name+type change events from free official ABR GUID web services. Not CreditorWatch. Not a nationwide ABN dump.

actors.name: au-apvma-product-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Australia APVMA Product No Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch Australia APVMA Product Numbers (pcode) and emit typed REGISTERED/APPROVED/APPEARED/DROPPED/REGCODE_CHANGED/EXPIRY_CHANGED events from data.gov.au PUBCRIS product.csv. Not EPA PPIS/PMRA/ACMA/ABN twin; not a national dump billed as rows.

actors.name: au-asic-credit-licence-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Australia ASIC Credit Licence Number Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch ASIC Credit Licence Numbers for membership, status (APPR/SUSP), name, authorisation, AFSL, end-date and EDRS changes from the official weekly CSV. PPE on unique portfolio events. Not an AFSL twin; not a register dump billed as rows.

actors.name: au-qld-ea-permit-reference-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Queensland EA Permit Reference Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch Queensland Environmental Authority Permit References; emit APPEARED/DROPPED/STATUS_CHANGED and attribute events from the official DESI ea-register.xlsx. Not an ASIC Credit twin; not a full EA dump billed as rows.

actors.name: au-qld-enforcement-reference-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Queensland Enforcement Reference Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch Queensland DESI Environmental Enforcement Action References; emit APPEARED/DROPPED/STATUS_CHANGED and attribute events from the official enforcements-register.xlsx (latest Issued Date collapse). Not a QLD EA Permit twin; not a full dump billed as rows.

actors.name: brazil-cnpj-situacao-change-monitor
actors.title: Brazil CNPJ Situação Change Monitor (honest monthly lag)
actors.description: Watch a list of Brazilian CNPJs and emit typed situação cadastral / material change events from Receita Federal dados abertos (or equivalent open-data mirror). Honest monthly official lag — not a CNPJ dump, not paid Serasa.

actors.name: lookalike-ct-brand-abuse-monitor
actors.title: Lookalike Domain CT Brand-Abuse Monitor
actors.description: Generate lookalikes (dnstwist-class, in-process) for brand apexes, join public CT via crt.sh, and emit LOOKALIKE_CERT_ISSUED events when a lookalike gets a new TLS cert. Not a TLS dump; not dnstwist-only.

actors.name: iana-icann-registrar-id-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: IANA/ICANN Registrar ID Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch IANA Registrar IDs; emit APPEARED/DROPPED/STATUS_CHANGED/NAME_CHANGED/RDAP_URL_CHANGED from the official IANA registrar-ids CSV. Not a WHOIS/RDAP domain twin; not a full IANA dump billed as rows.

actors.name: icann-gtld-registry-operator-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: ICANN gTLD Registry-Operator Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch ICANN gTLD strings for registry-operator / contract portfolio status changes from the official gtlds.json feed (DELEGATED, CONTRACT_TERMINATED, REMOVED). Not an IANA Registrar ID twin; not a WHOIS/zone-file domain twin; not a full gTLD dump billed as rows.

actors.name: ch-swissmedic-zulassungsnummer-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Swissmedic Zulassungsnummer Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch Swissmedic Zulassungsnummer against the official HAM authorized-medicines xlsx and emit typed APPEARED/DROPPED/AUTHORIZATION_ON/OFF (+ optional attribute) events. Dosage rows aggregated to auth portfolio. Not EMA/FDA twin; not a full dump billed as rows.
